entries.title: PostReady: PR #903 — Show which platforms can't publish yet
entries.description: Connect Socials page now surfaces platforms that are connected but not yet live for publishing, reducing user confusion during API approval period.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #902 — Introductory pricing replaces 7-day free trial
entries.description: Pricing page switched from free-trial model to introductory pricing, aligning with single-plan positioning.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #901 — Hide Video end card in brand kit
entries.description: Brand kit Video end card hidden — Bring to Life feature gates this via engine rather than brand-kit configuration.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #898 — Slim Plan & Billing card
entries.description: Plan & Billing settings card slimmed down for cleaner layout in the single-plan pricing model.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #896 — Settings timezone picker + honest billing and referral copy
entries.description: Profile card gets a timezone picker for accurate local-time scheduling; billing and referral copy updated to be accurate and honest.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #895 — Dark connected cards, progress banner, overflow menu
entries.description: Connect Socials page updated: connected cards styled dark for visual consistency, progress banner and overflow menu added.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #894 — Carousel export size icons + download label
entries.description: Carousel export sizes now displayed as shape icons (visual); labels clarified to indicate these are download-only export presets.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #893 — Teammate invite for customer accounts
entries.description: New feature: customers can now invite a teammate onto their own PostReady account, enabling multi-user collaboration.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #892 — Manual timezone override + schedule travel fix
entries.description: Fix: manual timezone override added to Schedule page; travel no longer silently shifts the schedule when crossing time zones.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #890 — Landing copy: stop reading as social media manager replacement
entries.description: Landing page copy fix — page was inadvertently positioning PostReady as a social media manager replacement; repositioned to clarify its distinct value proposition.
